The eval string only calls the predefined _package_i18n function with arguments from the array, which is a standard AUR maintainer pattern for creating multiple sub-packages. No network requests, no downloads of untrusted code, and no data exfiltration occur during sourcing. The _google_api_key variable is a static string assigned at top level but is not used until inside the prepare() function, which is out of scope for this gate. All source URLs are from Mozilla's official archive, and checksums include many 'SKIP' entries, which are permitted and do not trigger downloads at this step. Consequently, running makepkg --printsrcinfo executes no genuinely malicious code.
